title: NinjaOne (unofficial)
auth: OAuth client credentials: a NinjaOne API Services client app with the monitoring scope, and the instance host as a connection setting
author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This connector lets Sophos Fusion playbooks search NinjaOne devices and read a device or an organization through the NinjaOne public API (v2). It only reads. The connection signs in with OAuth client credentials from a NinjaOne API Services client app with the monitoring scope, and takes the instance host as a connection setting.
notes:
Testing:
- Not run against NinjaOne: there was no instance to test with.
- On 2026-10-21 a renamed copy imported into a Sophos Fusion tenant, exported again, and was deleted.

Known gaps:
- How Sophos Fusion's OAuth Client Credentials handler sends the client secret, the device search response shape and the device link format are untested.
